transcript.answer: Yes. Issue #498 in re-cinq/Otto is open. It is titled "Stop the tool-budget message promising a follow-up while no escalation destination exists". It is labelled type:bug, priority:medium and lore:blocked, and saadahmed95 opened it on 2026-10-23. The Danish message TOOL_BUDGET_MESSAGE_DA (#151, shipped in #439) ends with "En kollega vil følge op på din henvendelse." ("A colleague will follow up on your enquiry"). With no escalation destination configured, nobody is notified, and the record stays at no_destination_configured. The re:cinq test environment runs this way while KU-14 is open. The FR-017 test doesn't forbid a promised follow-up, so it passes anyway. The issue is blocked on two things: a decision on what the message may promise (KU-14) and a Danish speaker for any new wording (KU-15). The same question also blocks #460's FR-013 and FR-014.

judgements.reason: The answer says yes, there is an open bug, which matches the gold answer; the extra detail does not contradict it.
